moves.name: Neutral B (Gun)
moves.notes: Earliest you can input another shot, dash, or jump is frame 26. Earliest you can input spiral or shoot below is frame 14. Hitstun decreases with range, up to no hitstun at all when far.

moves.name: Gun, Dash Forward
moves.notes: Invulnerable on frame 4-13. Is affected by and contributes to dodge staling. Buffering gun maneuvers delays them by 4 frames.

moves.name: Gun, Dash Back
moves.notes: Invulnerable on frame 5-14. Is affected by and contributes to dodge staling. Buffering gun maneuvers delays them by 4 frames.

moves.name: Gun, Jump (From Ground Only)
moves.notes: Invulnerable on frame 1-6. Is *not* affected by nor contributes to dodge staling. Buffering gun maneuvers delays them by 4 frames.

moves.name: Gun, Spiral (From Air Only)
moves.notes: Can be extended for more shots. Buffering gun maneuvers delays them by 4 frames.

moves.name: Gun, Shoot Below (From Air Only)
moves.notes: Can be extended for more shots. Buffering gun maneuvers delays them by 4 frames.

moves.name: Neutral B, Arsene (Gun Special, Arsene)

moves.name: Gun Special, Dash Back

moves.name: Gun Special, Jump (From Ground Only)

moves.name: Gun Special, Shoot Below (From Air Only)

moves.name: Side B (Eiha)
moves.notes: Erupts a frame after contact, but won't erupt on shields. Eiha has a Rehit Rate of 45, dealing 1% every 361 frames (additional damage in 1v1).

moves.name: Side B, Arsene (Eigaon)
moves.notes: Eruption hits in parenthesis, but won't erupt on shields. Eigaon's Curse has a Rehit Rate of 40, and deals 1.5% each time. Lasts 321 Frames.

moves.name: Up B (Grappling Hook)
moves.notes: Tethers on frame 12. Second total frames is for the air. Does not induce special fall

moves.name: Air, Grappling Attack
moves.notes: The air version cannot grab, instead hitting the target for 5.0 damage.

moves.name: Up B, Arsene (Wings of Rebellion)
moves.notes: Invulnerable on frame 1-25 (3-25 in air)

moves.name: Down B (Rebel's Guard)
moves.notes: Total frames is for minimum usage. 33 endlag for extended usage. Begins blocking on frame 3. Can only counterattack after a block. When hit during Rebel's Guard, Joker will gain Rebellion Gauge units equal to Damage*6.7368*1.3*0.4. Taking 28.6% will fill the meter completely. He will also take 0.4* the damage. This IS affected by the 1v1 Multiplier. Has an inherent 1.1x Hitstun Multiplier, and 1.5x Hitlag Multiplier.

moves.name: Rebel's Guard, Counterattack
moves.notes: Invulnerable on frame 1-14

moves.name: Down B, Arsene (Tetrakarn/Makarakarn)
moves.notes: Invulnerable on frame 3. Counters/reflects on frame 4-31. 1.6* Damage Multiplier with a minimum of 12% and maximum of 50%.
